about.title: About the prototype
about.p1: This is a minimum viable product (MVP) of the Armenian cultural heritage portal built according to the technical specification in docs/tz-heritage-portal.md. It shows how the aggregation pipeline, search, object pages and multilingual interface work together.
about.p2: The only source so far is the State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation. The project's classifier selected {records} records that strongly relate to Armenian heritage. Another {candidates} candidate records need manual review and are not published.
about.p3: Metadata are shown in Russian, the language of the source. People, places and subjects are linked automatically with the project's term registry. Images are displayed directly from the source server; their rights status has not been stated.
about.p4: Interface translations are drafts and have to be checked by native speakers before public launch.
about.not_included: Other sources (Europeana, NEB and others), machine translation of metadata, local image copies with IIIF Image API, administration and curator review queue, user accounts, map and timeline, OAI-PMH.
footer.data: Metadata: State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation. Images belong to their holders; rights not evaluated.
